title: Trump ties $5,000 payment promise to a full Republican midterm sweep
description: A pledge of this scale, if it were ever legislated, would represent a meaningful debt expansion at a moment when concerns about the deficit and Treasury issuance are already weighing on bond markets. For now, the promise is conditional on a Republican sweep in November and carries no funding mechanism or legislative pathway, so it is unlikely to move markets in the near term.
